summary: The account values and a holding arrive; the download end never does. The unsubscribe sent at the deadline is answered with error 2100.

provenance.why: Nothing of the owner's account may be committed (the repository is public), so no account conversation is ever captured into it (ADR 0030).
provenance.built: Laid out as ibapi 9.81's decoder at server version 157 (decoder.py processPortfolioValueMsg; updateAccountValue, updateAccountTime, accountDownloadEnd and managedAccounts by their EWrapper signatures) and its reqAccountUpdates encoder, read on 2026-11-23; then checked against a capture of the live gateway on 2026-11-23 (server version 157), none of whose values is in the repository: the handshake's order and notices, the keys and currency tags of the account values (the P&L only under $LEDGER-, NetLiquidation and TotalCashValue plain in the base code beside their -S rows), the spellings of a stock's and an option's portfolio row, the update time interleaved with the portfolio, and error 2100 after each unsubscribe; cut before the download end.
provenance.invented: Every symbol, contract id, quantity, price, value, total, exchange rate, clock time and account id in this file is invented; the accounts are placeholders.

onStartApi: Market data farm connection is OK:usfarm
HMDS data farm connection is OK:ushmds
Sec-def data farm connection is OK:secdefil

onCancel: API client has been unsubscribed from account data.
